prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1050
Claimant:
Diane Jones
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2024-07-21
First notice of loss received from the policyholder's driver reporting a low-speed collision in a parking lot with another
vehicle, with a head injury described as a concussion. Claimant is not represented by counsel at this time.
2024-08-18
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of the reported loss. Nothing in
the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
2024-08-24
Spoke with the claimant, who described the same sequence of events as in the initial report, including the
approximate speed and the point of impact. The account has not changed across contacts.
2024-08-29
Police report on file lists the claimant as an occupant of the vehicle at the scene, and a responding officer's notes
match the described position of both cars.
2024-10-17
Reviewed photographs submitted by the claimant. They confirm several details of the impact, including the location of
the damage and the resting positions of the vehicles.
2024-10-29
No independent witnesses have come forward. Asked the claimant for any other sources of information and will follow
up if anything is produced.
2024-10-30
Damage to the vehicle is mostly consistent with the impact described. Obtained a repair estimate from the body shop
and am comparing it against the photos.
2024-11-19
Checked prior loss history on the vehicle. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known to exist.
2024-12-04
Claimant reports a concussion from the collision, with headaches and dizziness in the days that followed. The
reported injury is plausible for a collision of this type.
2025-01-12
Medical records show a course of treatment that followed a usual pattern, with visits tapering as symptoms improved.
Records also note a minor strain to the same general area several years ago, which resolved fully with no ongoing
issues.
2025-01-24
Discussed the prior strain with the claimant, who confirmed it and said it had healed completely. The treating
provider's notes support that account, and the current injury appears separate from it.
2025-02-09
Claim review is on hold pending the final medical bills and the repair invoice. Current assessment is that the reported
loss and injury are consistent with the available evidence.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
